propositions: Three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) in adapters/jira/acli_graph.py paginate through opaque nextPageToken cursors but have test coverage only for single-page responses

The cursor contract requires termination on isLast OR null/absent nextPageToken, with advance validated on recorded request bodies, but no test asserts cursor advancement or both stop conditions independently
A structural anti-regression guard must scan adapters/jira/*.py to prevent future pagination skips in whole-project readers that POST to /rest/api/3/search/jql
A real defect (rebar:cabc-7a98-d173-4d7c) exists where repeated cursor tokens cause infinite loops, converted to xfail(strict=True) pending production fix
Mutations must verify that breaking the loop after page one fails the test suite, that short pages do not terminate the walk, and that both stop conditions are independently necessary
